title: galium reboudiana
intro: Galium reboudiana, commonly known as the New Zealand spinach or tree spinach, is a perennial herb native to New Zealand and Australia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Galium reboudiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. These compounds contribute to the plant's ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote overall well-being.
